messages:
elaine: Quick async  need to lock decisions on slimline packaging and network handoff before Tues customer workshop.
jasper: Quick list of decisions?
elaine: Installer profiles (slimline vs ops), minimal preflight checks, upgrade downtime expectations, who owns allowlist comms.
maria: Field asks: slimline = no relay, minimal surface; ops = relay + support hooks. They want a one-page allowlist snippet for NetOps.
frank: Upgrade story from infra: minor patches = rolling operator updates with short pod drains; major = operator-led migration requiring maintenance window. We estimate 20-40s per node for minor rolling.
jasper: Engineering proposes CLI-first installer for alpha. Console flows later. Preflight should fail fast with explicit remediation steps.
netops: For customer-managed networking we define 3 variants: relay-managed, outbound-only (NAT), and airgapped. Different docs and test expectations for each.
maria: Pilots prefer outbound-only. Also ask that we surface an "egress sample" they can paste to firewall teams.
frank: Example slimline config snippet for the installer:
```
profile: slimline
network: customer-nat
egress.allowlist: ["203.0.113.45"]
upgrade.strategy: rolling
```
jasper: Preflight checklist idea: 1) egress to control-plane endpoints on 443, 2) DNS resolve control-plane hostnames, 3) test TLS handshake, 4) operator RBAC checks. Block install on failure with remediation text.
netops: We'll produce a single-page NetOps checklist and an allowlist snippet. Need security to review wording.
maria: Upgrade rollback ask: staged canary (1 node or 5% tenants) + manual revert token to force rollback. Customers want automatic revert on error-rate spike.
frank: Runtime note: KV cache compatibility only across minor semver increments. Major schema changes require explicit migration; we'll include hooks in the runbook.
elaine: Proposed launch gates: (A) slimline + ops profiles done; (B) preflight + docs; (C) minor in-place upgrade validated with canary + revert; (D) allowlist doc signed by security; (E) major runbook drafted.
j asper: timeline: Q3 alpha = A,B,D (CLI); Q4 = C; Q1 = E. Legal/security sign-off required for allowlist.
maria: I'll recruit 3 pilots for Q3 alpha; CLI-first is fine.
frank: I'll prototype revert token and runbook snippets this week.
deploy-bot: Jira RDW-PRIV-555 created: "Slimline & ops installer + preflight checks".
elaine: Action items: jasper - installer templates + preflight (1w); frank - runbook + revert token (2w); maria - pilots (2w); netops - allowlist one-pager (1w). Flag blockers here.
jasper: No infra blockers. Will post PR with templates by Fri EOD.
maria: Scheduling pilots now.
frank: Sharing rollback prototype Thurs.
elaine: Thanks all  will update roadmap doc and ping security/legal. :thumbsup:
